cause: PowerShell 5 emitted JSON using its native console code page; Node decoded bytes as UTF-8, corrupting Chinese shortcut/data path values. Source BOM already protected script literals but did not control stdout.
evidence: ENOENT opening the second test's Chinese shortcut path from the decoded management receipt. First test lacked an assertion that the real requested Chinese data directory was used.
repair: Set per-process UTF-8 Console.OutputEncoding/OutputEncoding in both new entry scripts, and assert the original Chinese data path in the receipt plus the actual SQLite file in that directory.
scope: Own temporary shortcut folders and isolated disabled-model test service; no real current-user startup registration or primary service change
